annotation.summary_en: During their 25th anniversary celebration, a couple decides to be honest about their past infidelities, leading to shocking revelations from the wife.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a living room where a man in a suit (Vardan) and his wife, Mareta (played by a male actor in drag wearing a wig and red lipstick), are celebrating their 25th wedding anniversary with champagne and snacks. Vardan makes a long, sentimental speech about their years together, their children, and their endurance through arguments. He eventually confesses that he cheated once at a sauna during a friend's birthday party after initially refusing. When he asks Mareta if she has ever been unfaithful, she calmly admits to three instances. She explains each time as a sacrifice for his benefit: first, she slept with a factory director to get Vardan a job; second, she slept with a chief surgeon to secure a life-saving surgery for Vardan when they had no money; and third, she slept with seventy people to secure the final seventy votes he needed to be elected as a member of parliament. The punchline highlights the massive scale of her 'sacrifices' compared to his single incident.
catchphrases: Բա որ երկրորդը եղելա, Առաջինն էլա եղել
